JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN major maj ON m.link_to_major = maj.major_id
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE maj.major_name = 'interior design' AND e.event_name = 'Community Theater';

SELECT SUM(e.cost) AS total_expense
FROM event ev
JOIN budget b ON ev.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense e ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE ev.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff'
GROUP BY m.member_id
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.event_name, SUM(ex.cost) AS total_cost
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
GROUP BY e.event_id
ORDER BY total_cost ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_name = 'Yearly Kickoff' THEN ex.cost ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ex.cost), 0)) AS percentage
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_event) AS event_count, mj.major_name
FROM attendance a
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Luisa' AND m.last_name = 'Guidi'
GROUP BY mj.major_name;

SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes' 
        ELSE 'No' 
    END AS did_attend
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya' 
    AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' 
    AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT e.cost FROM expense e JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id WHERE e.expense_description LIKE '%poster%' AND ev.event_name = 'September Speaker';

SELECT e.type, SUM(exp.cost) AS total_approved_value
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense exp ON b.budget_id = exp.link_to_budget
WHERE e.event_name = 'October Meeting' AND exp.approved = 'TRUE'
GROUP BY e.type;

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.position = 'vice president'
  AND e.location = '900 E. Washington St.'
  AND e.type = 'social'
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = "women's soccer"

SELECT e.event_name, e.event_date
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
JOIN expense ex ON b.budget_id = ex.link_to_budget
WHERE ex.expense_description LIKE '%pizza%'
  AND ex.cost > 50
  AND ex.cost < 100;

SELECT z.city, z.county
FROM income i
JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
GROUP BY z.city, z.county
HAVING COUNT(i.income_id) > 40;

SELECT m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_paid
FROM member m
JOIN expense exp ON m.member_id = exp.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON exp.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
GROUP BY m.member_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
ORDER BY total_paid DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    (SUM(e.cost) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense)) AS percentage
FROM 
    expense e
    JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE 
    ev.type = 'game'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_spending
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_spending DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name, i.amount
FROM member m
JOIN income i ON m.member_id = i.link_to_member
WHERE i.date_received = '9/9/2019';

SELECT DISTINCT p.Description
FROM transactions_1k t
JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID
WHERE t.Date LIKE '2013-09%';

SELECT account_id, MIN(average_salary) AS lowest_avg_salary, (MAX(average_salary) - MIN(average_salary)) AS salary_gap
FROM account
JOIN client ON account.location_of_branch = client.location_of_branch
WHERE client.gender = 'female'
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY client.birth_date ASC, lowest_avg_salary ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT account_id
FROM account
WHERE location_of_branch IN (
    SELECT location_of_branch
    FROM client
    WHERE birth_date = (
        SELECT MAX(birth_date)
        FROM client
    )
)
AND location_of_branch IN (
    SELECT location_of_branch
    FROM district
    WHERE average_salary = (
        SELECT MAX(average_salary)
        FROM district
    )
);

SELECT p.birth_date
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan AS l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.amount = 98832 AND l.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT 
    (t2.balance_after_transaction - t1.balance_after_transaction) * 100.0 / t1.balance_after_transaction AS increase_rate_percent
FROM 
    account a
JOIN 
    loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN 
    trans t1 ON a.account_id = t1.account_id
JOIN 
    trans t2 ON a.account_id = t2.account_id
WHERE 
    l.date = '1993-07-05'
    AND t1.date_of_transaction = '1993-03-22'
    AND t2.date_of_transaction = '1998-12-27';

SELECT d.district_name, d.region
FROM district d
JOIN account a ON d.location_of_branch = a.location_of_branch
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.loan_id = 4990;

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.average_salary, loan.duration
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.location_of_branch = district.location_of_branch
WHERE loan.duration = 60;

SELECT 
    d.district_name,
    d.region,
    ((d."unemployment rate 1996" - d."unemployment rate 1995") / d."unemployment rate 1995" * 100) AS unemployment_rate_increment_percentage
FROM 
    loan l
JOIN 
    account a ON l.account_id = a."account id"
JOIN 
    disp dp ON a."account id" = dp.account_id
JOIN 
    client c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN 
    district d ON c."location of branch" = d."location of branch"
WHERE 
    l.status = 'running' 
    AND l.amount > 0
GROUP BY 
    d.district_name, d.region, d."unemployment rate 1995", d."unemployment rate 1996";

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) 
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district dt ON a.location_of_branch = dt.location_of_branch
WHERE dt.district_name = 'South Bohemia' 
  AND d.type = 'OWNER' 
  AND d.disposition_id NOT IN (
      SELECT disposition_id 
      FROM card
  );

SELECT location_of_branch, COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE loan.status = 'active'
GROUP BY location_of_branch
ORDER BY loan_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(amount) AS average_loan_amount
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'male';

SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id, c.customer_name
FROM customers c
JOIN sales_orders so ON c.customer_id = so._Customer_ID
JOIN products p ON so._Product_ID = p.product_id
JOIN store_locations sl ON so._Store_ID = sl.Store_ID
WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%household payment%' AND sl.City_Name = 'Pisek';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cr ON d.disposition_id = cr.disposition_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'female' AND cr.type = 'credit';
SELECT * FROM trans WHERE account_id = 3356 AND mode_of_transaction = 'cash' AND characterization_of_the_transaction = 'withdrawal';
SELECT type FROM card WHERE disposition_id IN (SELECT disposition_id FROM disp WHERE client_id = 13539);

SELECT 
    (SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', date) = '1997' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) - 
     SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', date) = '1996' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / 
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN strftime('%Y', date) = '1996' THEN amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS growth_rate_percent
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.gender = 'male'
    AND strftime('%Y', loan.date) IN ('1996', '1997');
SELECT birth_date FROM client WHERE client_id = 130;

SELECT loan.amount, loan.status
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 992;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disposition_id = disp.disposition_id
WHERE disp.client_id = 9;

SELECT client_id
FROM client
WHERE gender = 'female'
ORDER BY (
    SELECT MAX(amount)
    FROM loan
    WHERE loan.account_id IN (
        SELECT account_id
        FROM disp
        WHERE disp.client_id = client.client_id
    )
) DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id)
FROM customers c
JOIN transactions_1k t ON c.CustomerID = t."Customer ID"
WHERE c.client_segment = 'home'
  AND t.Amount > 4000
  AND c.Currency = 'USD'
  AND c.CustomerID IN (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM customers
    WHERE client_segment = 'male'
      AND CustomerID BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card cr ON d.disposition_id = cr.disposition_id
WHERE c.gender = 'female' AND cr.type = 'junior';

SELECT AVG(carcinogenic_count) AS avg_carcinogenic_single_bonded
FROM (
    SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS carcinogenic_count
    FROM molecule m
    JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
    JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
    JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE m.label = 'carcinogenic' AND b.bond_type = 'single'
    GROUP BY m.molecule_id
) carcinogenic_molecules;
SELECT bond_type FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'Tellurium');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN connected ON atom.atom_id = connected.atom_id
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element IN ('I', 'S')
AND bond.bond_type = 'single'
AND molecule.label = 'single';
SELECT bond_id, molecule_id, bond_type FROM bond WHERE bond_type = 'triple';

SELECT DISTINCT bond.bond_type
FROM bond
JOIN atom ON bond.molecule_id = atom.molecule_id
WHERE atom.element = 'Tin';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond_id) FROM bond WHERE molecule_id IN (SELECT molecule_id FROM atom WHERE element = 'iodine');

SELECT DISTINCT a1.element, a2.element
FROM atom a1
JOIN connected c ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id_2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_10_11';

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON t.Id = p.Id
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'John Stauffer';

SELECT Id
FROM posts
WHERE OwnerDisplayName = 'slashnick'
ORDER BY AnswerCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    users.DisplayName,
    COUNT(posts.Id) AS post_count,
    SUM(posts.Score) AS total_score,
    SUM(posts.ViewCount) AS total_views,
    SUM(posts.AnswerCount) AS total_answers,
    SUM(posts.CommentCount) AS total_comments,
    SUM(posts.FavoriteCount) AS total_favorites
FROM 
    users
JOIN 
    posts ON users.Id = posts.OwnerUserId
WHERE 
    users.DisplayName IN ('Harvey Motulsky', 'Noah Snyder')
GROUP BY 
    users.DisplayName
ORDER BY 
    total_score DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT t.TagName
FROM tags t
JOIN posts p ON t.ExcerptPostId = p.Id OR t.WikiPostId = p.Id
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
AND p.CommentCount = 0;

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT posts.Id) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts WHERE posts.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL)) AS percentage
FROM posts
JOIN users ON posts.OwnerUserId = users.Id
WHERE posts.Tags LIKE '%<r>%' OR posts.Tags LIKE '%r%';

SELECT 
    (SELECT SUM(ViewCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerDisplayName = 'mornington') - 
    (SELECT SUM(ViewCount) FROM posts WHERE OwnerDisplayName = 'Amos')
FROM posts LIMIT 1;

FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Super Strength'
AND superhero.height_cm > 200;

FROM superhero
JOIN colour AS eye_colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = eye_colour.id
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id

SELECT 
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN sp.power_name = 'Super Strength' THEN s.id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id)) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
LEFT JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

FROM superhero s

JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name

JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower p ON hp.power_id = p.id
WHERE p.power_name = 'flight';

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'adaptation';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero.superhero sh
JOIN superhero.hero_power hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superhero.superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Hunter Zolomon';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN hero_power hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

SELECT alignment.alignment, superpower.power_name
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id

FROM superhero AS sh
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON sh.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, r.points
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d."driver ID" = r."driver ID"
JOIN races ra ON r."race ID" = ra."race ID"
WHERE ra.year = 2017 AND ra.name LIKE '%Chinese%Grand Prix%'
ORDER BY r.points DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    (COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) 
                         FROM results r2 
                         JOIN races ra2 ON r2.race_id = ra2.race_id 
                         WHERE ra2.year >= 2010 
                           AND r2.driver_id = (SELECT driver_id FROM drivers WHERE surname = 'Hamilton'))) AS percentage
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.race_id = ra.race_id
WHERE ra.year >= 2010
  AND r.driver_id = (SELECT driver_id FROM drivers WHERE surname = 'Hamilton')
  AND r.grid != 1;

SELECT DISTINCT races.name 
FROM races 
JOIN results ON races.raceID = results.raceID 
JOIN drivers ON results.driverID = drivers.driverID 
WHERE drivers.forename = 'Alex' 
  AND drivers.surname = 'Yoong' 
  AND results.grid < 10;

SELECT r.name, r.date, res.points
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON d.driverID = res.driverID
JOIN races r ON res.raceID = r.raceID
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT r.name
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceID = res.raceID
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverID = d.driverID
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT DISTINCT r.year
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceID = res.raceID
JOIN drivers d ON res.driverID = d.driverID
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverID)
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverID = r.driverID
JOIN races ra ON r.raceID = ra.raceID
WHERE ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name LIKE '%Australian Grand Prix%'
  AND d.nationality = 'American';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverID)
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverID = r.driverID
JOIN races ra ON r.raceID = ra.raceID
WHERE d.nationality = 'American' AND r.statusId IN (SELECT statusID FROM status WHERE status LIKE '%Disqualified%');

SELECT AVG(points) 
FROM results 
JOIN races ON results.race_id = races.race_id 
WHERE races.name LIKE '%Turkish Grand Prix%' 
AND results.driver_id = (SELECT driver_id FROM drivers WHERE surname = 'Hamilton' AND forename = 'Lewis');

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON d."driver ID" = q."driver Id"
JOIN races r ON q."race Id" = r."race ID"
JOIN circuits c ON r."Circuit Id" = c."circuit Id"
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.position = 1
  AND q.number = 3;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality, r.name AS race_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON d.driverID = res.driverID
JOIN races r ON res.raceID = r.raceID
WHERE d.driverID = (
    SELECT driverID
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY date_of_birth DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.date
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name AS circuit_name, l.lap, l.time AS lap_time, d.forename, d.surname
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c."circuit Id" = r."Circuit Id"
JOIN laptimes l ON r."race ID" = l."race ID"
JOIN drivers d ON l."driver ID" = d."driver ID"
WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
ORDER BY c.name, l.lap;

SELECT pitstops.duration
FROM pitstops
JOIN races ON pitstops.race_id = races.race_id
JOIN circuits ON races.circuit_id = circuits.circuit_id
WHERE circuits.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
AND pitstops.driver_id = (
    SELECT laptimes.driver_id
    FROM laptimes
    JOIN races AS r2 ON laptimes.race_id = r2.race_id
    JOIN circuits AS c2 ON r2.circuit_id = c2.circuit_id
    WHERE c2.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
    ORDER BY laptimes.milliseconds ASC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND pitstops.race_id = (
    SELECT laptimes.race_id
    FROM laptimes
    JOIN races AS r3 ON laptimes.race_id = r3.race_id
    JOIN circuits AS c3 ON r3.circuit_id = c3.circuit_id
    WHERE c3.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix Circuit'
    ORDER BY laptimes.milliseconds ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT c.latitude, c.longitude
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c."circuit Id" = r."Circuit Id"
JOIN results rs ON r."race ID" = rs."race ID"
WHERE rs."fastest Lap Time" = '1:29.488';

SELECT AVG(laptimes.milliseconds) 
FROM laptimes 
JOIN races ON laptimes.raceID = races.raceID 
JOIN circuits ON races.CircuitId = circuits.circuitId 
WHERE circuits.country = 'Italy';
SELECT player_name FROM player WHERE nation = 'Belgium';

SELECT country, AVG(weight) AS avg_weight

WITH first_loan_client AS (
    SELECT l.account_id
    FROM loan l
    WHERE l.date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY l.loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_start AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t.account_id = flc.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_end AS (
    SELECT t.account_id, t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN first_loan_client flc ON t.account_id = flc.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
    (be.balance - bs.balance) * 100.0 / bs.balance AS increase_rate_percent
FROM balance_start bs
JOIN balance_end be ON bs.account_id = be.account_id;
